newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Peter Guilford said the Commission had launched a strategy to insure long and stable relations with Hong Kong after its handover to China in July. Guilford said a Commission communication emphasised the need to underline Hong Kong's importance for the EU and to underpin its autonomy while respecting its sovereignty. Guilford also said the EU had to remain vigilant on developments in Hong Kong, including the human rights situation.

Spokeswoman Sarah Lambert said the Commission had sent a letter to the Italian authorities concerning its aid to airline company Alitalia. Lambert said the Commission had suggested changes to the restructuring plan.

In answer to a question, spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission regretted the leaks concerning the Commission economic forecasts that led to an impression that the statistical figures were politicised.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/330: An overall view of energy policy and actions.
- IP/97/331: The economic situation in the European Union.
- IP/97/332: External aspects of Economic and Monetary Union.
- IP/97/333: Commission to recover ECU 539 million of CAP expenditure from the Member States.
- IP/97/334: Extension of safeguard measures on rice imports from the Overseas Countries and Territories (OCT).
- IP/97/335: Commission launches new policy on Hong Kong.
- IP/97/336: Commission launches new initiative to prevent indirect tax fraud.
- IP/97/337: State Aids: Netherlands - The Commission has decided to open the procedure for possible aid to Philips and Rabobank under the technolease transaction.
- IP/97/339: Commission proposes the creation of a Community framework for airport charges.
- IP/97/340: Commission calls for a continent-wide European transport network to meet the needs of the 21st century.
- IP/97/342: Investment, deregulation and trade covered by high-level EU-Japan talks.
- Commission's recommendation for the broad guidelines of the economic policies of the Member States and the Community.
- External aspects of Economic and Monetary Union.
- The Community Economy in 1996-98 - Spring 1997 economic forecast.
- CAP 2000 working document - long term prospects - grains, milk and meat markets.
- Eurostat news release No 30/97: ECU 46.3 Bn surplus with rest-of-world.
- Selling prices of petroleum products in ECU and US dollars.
- Oil bulletin No 864.
- ME97/23.4: Midday Express.
